info.name: Infoblox WAPI (Web API) DHCP Networks API

params.name: _return_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Use _return_fields+ to add fields to the default set.

params.name: _max_results
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. The default is 1000. Use a negative value to return all results.

params.name: network
params.description: Filter by the network address in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24).

params.name: network_view
params.description: Filter by the network view name.

params.name: comment
params.description: Filter by the comment associated with the network.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of IPv4 networks. Networks represent IP subnets and can contain DHCP ranges and fixed addresses. Supports filtering by network address, CIDR, network view, and comment.
Creates a new IPv4 network with the specified CIDR address. The network is created in the specified network view, or the default view if none is specified.

params.name: _return_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Use _return_fields+ to add fields to the default set.

params.name: _max_results
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. The default is 1000. Use a negative value to return all results.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by the network view name.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of network views. A network view provides a way to separate overlapping IP address spaces into distinct logical views.
